elements.name: Metrics
elements.definition: Quantified business outcomes the buyer expects from the change.
questions: What is this costing you today?
evidenceSignals: a number tied to an owner
a deadline attached to the number

anchors.3: A quantified outcome with an owner and a deadline.

exampleQuotes.1: We lose a lot of time on this.
exampleQuotes.3: The CFO reports the 11 day close to the board every quarter.

elements.nextQuestionAt1: What would you measure to know this worked?
failureModes: Rep supplies the number instead of the buyer.

elements.name: Economic Buyer
elements.definition: The person with the budget authority to approve the purchase.
questions: Who signs a purchase of this size?
evidenceSignals: direct contact with the budget holder

exampleQuotes.2: Dana holds the budget for this.
exampleQuotes.3: Dana joined the call and confirmed the budget.

elements.nextQuestionAt1: Who signs a purchase of this size?
